author: @cz_binance

source_evidence.description: Screenshot supplied by case owner, showing @cz_binance text; no original status ID or verified capture timestamp

new_claims.claim: CZ publicly presented rough arithmetic of ~$6.xB incident impact, ~$3B frozen, ~$1.xB SAFU, and ~$2B estimated remaining gap.
new_claims.boundary: Records attributed estimate only; no audit of freeze recoverability, fund segregation, double-counting, liabilities, or realized deficit.
new_claims.closure_test: Capture unique original X status, timestamp and independent reconciled line-item financing evidence.

new_claims.claim: CZ stated 'we have $1.x billion in SPCX alone'.
new_claims.boundary: Ownership entity, valuation timestamp, restrictions, pledge, liquidity, and availability for compensation are unverified; social statement is not asset proof.
new_claims.closure_test: Identify controlling legal entity and audited holding, applicable liquidity or transfer restrictions, financing proceeds if used, and actual loss coverage.

new_claims.claim: Later Binance statements, as reported, reference additional points of breach beyond initial compromised-laptop hypothesis.
new_claims.boundary: Subsequent reported preliminary position, not final technical root cause.
new_claims.closure_test: Capture original issuer update and reviewable post-mortem; retain the earlier initial hypothesis without overwriting.

notes: Numbers are rough and may not share an accounting cutoff. Frozen assets are not necessarily recovered; SAFU gross value is not evidence of available incremental liquidity; SPCX value is not compensation evidence. Do not infer final solvency.
